title: Locator Safety Function STPA
body:

[Top-level STPA](https://example.invalid/wiki/spaces/STPA/pages/100000001/Top-level+STPA) (System STPA)

[Sibling Function STPA](https://example.invalid/wiki/spaces/STPA/pages/100000002/Sibling+Function+STPA) (Complementary system STPA)


## Losses and Hazards

**HAZARD FOCUS**:

H1 - The vehicle comes too close to another vehicle, an object or a void

H2 - The vehicle starts to move when no motion is expected

H2.1 - People near the vehicle are unaware of its mode

H2.2 - Other vehicles are unaware of the vehicle's position and mode

H3 - The remote operator loses control of the vehicle

---

## Control Structure

The stop channel, when a fault is detected, tells nearby machines what to expect by broadcasting a radius.
Crossing the radius means a response is expected.

**Soft Stop** is a channel that asks the motion controller to bring the platform to a stop.

**Hard Stop** is a channel that cuts actuation power directly.

---

## Loss Scenarios

|  | **UCA** | **Type** | **Causal Factors** | **Constraints** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **UCA1 **The stop controller does not provide Soft Stop when the vehicle enters another machine's radius.*True Statement:**The vehicle is entering another machine's radius.* | **Type 1: **Inadequate control algorithm / hardware**Type 1: **Inadequate process model*Belief:**The radius belongs to the vehicle itself.***Type 2: **Inadequate feedback and information | The radius is not received. The position estimate is stale. | **CSTR1 **The stop controller must receive every radius broadcast within one second.**CSTR2 **A stale position must be treated as a fault. |
| 2 | **CA1 **The stop controller does provide Soft Stop when the vehicle enters another machine's radius. | **Type 3: **Control Path**Type 4: **Controlled Process | The command is sent but the motion controller does not act on it. | **CSTR1 **and **CSTR2 ****CSTR3 **The motion controller must latch a Soft Stop until the stop is achieved. |
| 3 | **UCA2 **The stop controller does not provide Soft Stop when its own radius is being broadcast. | **Type 1: **Inadequate control algorithm / hardware**Type 2: **Inadequate feedback and information | Hardware or software failure. | **CSTR4 **A broadcast radius must imply a stop on the broadcasting machine. |
| 4 | **CA2** | **Type 3: **Control Path**Type 4: **Controlled Process | (covered on UCA1) | **CSTR1 **and **CSTR3** |
| 5 | **~~UCA3 ~~**~~The stop controller does not provide Soft Stop when the planner is guiding the vehicle into another machine.~~ | **~~Type 1: ~~**~~Inadequate control algorithm / hardware~~ | ~~(duplicate of UCA7)~~ | ~~**CSTR1**~~ |
| 6 | **UCA5 **The stop controller provides Soft Stop too late, after entering the radius. | **Type 1: **Inadequate control algorithm / hardware**Type 2: **Inadequate feedback and information | Processing delays. | **CSTR5 **Processing load must be measured at peak and the design must leave margin. |
| 7 | **CA5 **The stop controller provides Soft Stop on time, before or upon entering the radius. | **Type 3: **Control Path**Type 4: **Controlled Process | The motion controller is slow to respond because its buffer is full. | **CSTR3 **and **CSTR5** |
| 8 | **UCA6 **The stop controller stops providing Soft Stop too soon, before the stop is achieved. *\[H1, H2\]* | **Type 1: **Inadequate process model*Belief:**The radius is gone.* | The radius broadcast is interrupted. | **CSTR3 **and **CSTR6 **Soft Stop, once initiated, must not be interrupted. |
| 9 | **UCA7 **The planner does not provide Operational Stop when approaching another machine. | **Type 1: **Inadequate process model*Belief:**The path will not intersect the other machine.* | The other machine is not in the planner's map. | **CSTR7 **The planner's map must include every machine that broadcasts. |
| 10 | **CA7 **The planner does provide Operational Stop when approaching another machine. | **Type 3: **Control Path**Type 4: **Controlled Process | Transmission failures. | **CSTR1 **and **CSTR7** |
| 11 | UCA8 The planner provides Operational Stop too late *\[H1\]* | **Type 1: **Inadequate control algorithm / hardware | Feedback delays. | **CSTR5 **and **CSTR7** |
| 12 |  | **Type 3: **Control Path**Type 4: **Controlled Process |  |  |
